data.command: What cron jobs are configured on this system?

data.text:
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ crontab -l
SHELL=/bin/bash
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
MAILTO=""

# nightly application backup
30 2    /home/webapp/bin/backup-app.sh >> /var/log/backup-app.log 2>&1

# weekly prune of old build artifacts
15 4   0 /home/webapp/bin/prune-artifacts.sh >> /var/log/prune-artifacts.log 2>&1

# local health probe, every 5 minutes
/5     curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz || logger -t healthz "web app health probe failed"

webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /etc/crontab
# /etc/crontab: system-wide crontab
# Unlike any other crontab you don't have to run the `crontab'
# command to install the new version when you edit this file
# and files in /etc/cron.d. These files also have username fields,
# that none of the other crontabs do.

SHELL=/bin/sh
# You can also override PATH, but by default, newer versions inherit it from the environment
#PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin

# Example of job definition:
# .---------------- minute (0 - 59)
# |  .------------- hour (0 - 23)
# |  |  .---------- day of month (1 - 31)
# |  |  |  .------- month (1 - 12) OR jan,feb,mar,apr ...
# |  |  |  |  .---- day of week (0 - 6) (Sunday=0 or 7) OR sun,mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat
# |  |  |  |  |
#          user-name command to be executed
17 	  	root    cd / && run-parts --report /etc/cron.hourly
25 6	  	root	test -x /usr/sbin/anacron || ( cd / && run-parts --report /etc/cron.daily )
47 6	  7	root	test -x /usr/sbin/anacron || ( cd / && run-parts --report /etc/cron.weekly )
52 6	1  	root	test -x /usr/sbin/anacron || ( cd / && run-parts --report /etc/cron.monthly )
#

webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ls -l /etc/cron.d/
total 8
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 201 Feb 11  2024 certbot
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 187 Nov  3  2023 docker-cleanup

webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /etc/cron.d/certbot
# /etc/cron.d/certbot - expires 2024-02-11
# This file is managed by certbot
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
0 /12    root test -x /usr/bin/certbot -a \! -d /run/systemd/system && perl -e 'sleep int(rand(43200))' && certbot -q renew

webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /etc/cron.d/docker-cleanup
# Removes stopped containers, unused networks and dangling images older than 7 days.
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
30 3   * root /usr/bin/docker system prune -af --filter "until=168h" >> /var/log/docker-prune.log 2>&1

webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ls -l /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly
/etc/cron.hourly:
total 0

/etc/cron.daily:
total 12
-rwxr-xr-x 1 root root 1478 Mar 22  2023 apt-compat
-rwxr-xr-x 1 root root  384 Apr  9  2023 dpkg
-rwxr-xr-x 1 root root  377 Jan 24  2023 logrotate

/etc/cron.monthly:
total 0

/etc/cron.weekly:
total 8
-rwxr-xr-x 1 root root 813 Feb 17  2023 man-db
